hypotheses.P0_factorial_recomposes: The four-factor Shapley decomposition exactly recomposes local L8H2 cue-edge writes and finite downstream contrasts to relative error at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.P1_hybrid_edge_preserves_native_transpor: The complete hybrid L8H2 cue edge shifts the disjoint spelling contrast correctly in at least 75% of examples in every cell.
hypotheses.P2_value_change_dominates_QK_change: The combined current-plus-persistent value contribution has greater signed mean than the two QK factors combined in every cell.
hypotheses.P3_value_is_a_cancellation_code: Persistent-bus and current-value Shapley means have opposite signs and each has magnitude at least as large as the total edge mean in every cell.
hypotheses.P4_QK_change_opposes_payload: The combined QK Shapley mean is negative in every cell.
hypotheses.P5_declared_contrast_beats_random: The complete edge and combined value contribution each exceed the 95th percentile of balanced random contrasts in at least five of six cells.
